brief.headline: Nifty Hits 25800.6 on Record FPI Inflows; Global AI Selloff Triggers Risk Off
brief.summary: Indian equities posted strong gains on Friday with Nifty 50 closing at 25800.60 and Bank Nifty surging 2.49%, backed by record FPI inflows exceeding ₹1 lakh crore in November so far. However, global sentiment worsened overnight as Nasdaq fell 4.72% amid a deepening retreat in AI tech stocks. Easing Brent Crude at 89.51 supports domestic macros, while a 4.42% drop in gold prices pressures gold loan financiers and jewelers.

takeaways.text: Nifty 50 surged 1.12% to 25800.60 driven by record monthly FPI inflows exceeding ₹1 lakh crore.
IndusInd Bank jumped 8.5% to ₹1,001 after returning to quarterly profitability, leading bank gains.
Sebi proposed eliminating extra disclosures for FPIs and limiting chief executive tenures at exchanges.
US tech stocks tumbled overnight as Nasdaq slid 4.72% amid a widening selloff in Anthropic and Nvidia.
Gold price decline of 4.42% sparked up to 5% drops in Muthoot Finance and Manappuram Finance.
Jefferies issued buy calls on Adani group shares, projecting up to 43% upside across selected tickers.

sections.india: Nifty 50 gained 1.12 per cent to 25800.60 while Sensex rose 1.08 per cent to 83919.71 on Friday, capping a 2.61 per cent weekly gain supported by FPI inflows exceeding ₹1 lakh crore in November. IndusInd Bank led banking stocks higher with an 8.5% rally to ₹1,001 following its return to quarterly profitability. Conversely, gold loan lenders Muthoot Finance and Manappuram Finance fell up to 5% as gold prices dropped to 3522.5, creating inventory loss risks for jewellers like Titan.
sections.world: US markets dropped sharply overnight as Nasdaq tumbled 4.72% to 22752.32 and the S&P 500 fell 3.15% to 6949.61 in a broad tech-led correction. Federal Reserve officials signaled growing urgency to maintain interest rate hikes to curb inflation, while a Reuters poll showed expectations for the RBI to raise its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.75% in December. Brent Crude eased to 89.51 while the US 10Y Yield dropped to 4.92.
sections.tech: Anthropic volatility increased following its $1.5 trillion Nasdaq listing, contributing to a sharp global tech selloff that wiped out Nasdaq's 2026 gains. The US SEC is investigating Nvidia accounting practices while AMD dropped up to 11% following short seller reports on China links. Indian IT stocks previously bucked global trends, gaining over 2% on value buying despite persistent AI capex skepticism.

stories.title: Sebi proposes limiting tenure of chief executives, independent directors at exchanges
stories.summary: India's Securities and Exchange Board is proposing crucial adjustments to governance norms affecting market institutions. Key suggestions include lowering the age threshold for public interest directors from 75 to 70 years, instituting a maximum of two three-year terms for directors, and restricting managing directors to an eight-year tenure. Current executives can finish their ongoing terms despite these proposed…
stories.ai_summary: Sebi has proposed limiting the tenure of chief executives and independent directors at market infrastructure institutions. The regulator also suggested lowering the age threshold for public interest directors.
stories.why_it_matters: Neutral to negative for exchange operators; tightens governance norms and executive leadership continuity.

stories.title: Sebi proposes easing disclosure rules for foreign funds
stories.summary: Sebi has proposed scrapping additional disclosure requirements for foreign portfolio investors, arguing that the rules are out of step with global practices and may deter overseas investment.
stories.ai_summary: Sebi proposed scrapping additional disclosure requirements for foreign portfolio investors to align with global practices. The move aims to eliminate friction and encourage overseas investment.
stories.why_it_matters: Positive for FPI inflows and capital market intermediaries by easing foreign compliance burdens.

stories.title: India's forex reserves fall $14.21 bn to $705.34 bn on revaluation
stories.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves declined by $14.21 billion in the week ended November 13, with falling gold reserves and foreign currency assets contributing to the drop.
stories.ai_summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by $14.21 billion to $705.34 billion for the week ended November 13. The decline was driven by lower gold reserves and foreign currency assets revaluation.
stories.why_it_matters: Negative for RBI intervention buffer, reflecting valuation losses on gold and foreign assets.

stories.title: Nasdaq tumbles 2% as Anthropic retreat deepens AI trade concerns
stories.summary: Following a rocky market debut, Anthropic’s stock price plunge led to a notable drop in the Nasdaq Composite index. The AI sector faces growing skepticism amidst high valuations and investment risks, putting pressure on major U.S. stock indexes. Despite some companies reporting strong earnings, investor anxiety persists over potential interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve.
stories.ai_summary: The Nasdaq Composite tumbled 2% as Anthropic's stock price plunge deepened concerns over AI sector valuations. The selloff highlights growing investor skepticism around high AI capital expenditure.
stories.why_it_matters: Negative for Indian IT sector sentiment due to global tech valuation derating.

stories.title: Bull run gathers pace! IndusInd Bank shares surge 8.5%, head for best week in over a year; Should investors still buy?
stories.summary: IndusInd Bank shares rose 8.5% to ₹1,001 on Friday, extending their weekly gains to nearly 9% and marking a fourth consecutive weekly advance. The rally followed a return to quarterly profitability, stronger core income and improved asset quality, though brokerages differ on the stock’s outlook.
stories.ai_summary: IndusInd Bank shares surged 8.5% to ₹1,001 on Friday, extending weekly gains to nearly 9%. The rally followed the private lender's return to quarterly profitability.
stories.why_it_matters: Positive for IndusInd Bank and private banks, signaling earnings recovery and sentiment turnaround.

stories.title: Markets gain 2.6% on FPI inflows, rupee rally and cooling crude oil prices

stories.title: Rupee surges to 7-month high, back below 93 against USD for first time since April 20, 2026
stories.summary: Traders and analysts are monitoring for signs that exporters are converting more of their dollar earnings, alongside continued portfolio inflows, to assess how much further the rupee could strengthen.

stories.why_it_matters: Positive for importers and domestic macro, but negative for export-oriented sectors like IT and pharma.

stories.title: Nifty hit 9-month high as Rupee logs best weekly rally in 5 weeks; Bond yields ease
stories.summary: Foreign investors pumped over ₹1 lakh crore into Indian equities in November so far, helping markets shrug off concerns around global technology stocks and elevated US yields.
stories.ai_summary: Nifty hit a 9-month high as foreign investors bought over ₹1 lakh crore of Indian equities in November so far. Easing bond yields and a strong weekly rupee performance further boosted domestic sentiment.
stories.why_it_matters: Positive for equity market sentiment as FPI buying reaches record monthly levels.

stories.title: RBI expected to raise rates in December, deliver final hike in February: Report
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.75% in December and take it to 6% in February as inflation breaches its 6% tolerance limit, a Reuters poll showed. Rising energy costs and uneven monsoon rainfall have intensified inflationary pressures.
stories.ai_summary: A Reuters poll indicates the RBI may raise its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.75% in December and 6% in February. The expected hikes follow inflation exceeding the central bank's 6% tolerance ceiling.
stories.why_it_matters: Negative for rate-sensitive sectors like real estate and autos; mixed for bank margins.

stories.summary: Amundi Investment Institute expects strong domestic demand, infrastructure spending and manufacturing growth to support the economy, even as inflation could breach the RBI’s target band.

Investors are concerned that further bullion declines could reduce loan demand, raise default risks and pressure lenders’ profitability.

The buying follows improved earnings, more appealing valuations and easing oil prices, though analysts warn flows could slow if crude rises or US bond yields increase.

This decision follows the tragic crash that killed Ajit Pawar and others on January 28. The funding includes improvements for fire safety, air traffic control, and runway infrastructure. An annual recurring budget of Rs 68.88 lakh has also been approved for airport operations and staffing.

stories.summary: The CAG is training officers to assess municipal revenue, borrowing and financial management as it begins thematic audits of 101 cities, starting with urban mobility this year.

stories.title: India's wheat area set for steepest decline in 26 years as farmers switch crops
stories.summary: India is experiencing its most severe decline in wheat acreage in 26 years due to insufficient monsoon rains. Farmers are shifting to less water-intensive crops like chickpeas and rapeseed, which promise better returns. The government's minimal increase in wheat procurement prices has also discouraged wheat planting among farmers. As a result, wheat acreage is expected to drop to its lowest level in four years.

stories.title: Fed’s Cook Sees Growing Urgency to Tackle Inflation
stories.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook sees an urgent need for the US central bank to raise interest rates to bring down inflation. Cook said Friday at a conference at Chile’s central bank in Santiago, “Inflation has been above target for more than five and a half years, and every additional day poses greater risk that price- and wage-setters will adjust their inflation expectations upward.” (Source: Bloomberg)

stories.title: Fed’s Paulson Argues for Deliberate Rate Hikes to Tame Inflation
stories.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia President Anna Paulson said she’d be open to considering back-to-back interest-rate hikes at the central bank’s upcoming policy meetings to help contain inflation, but said officials should move at a “deliberate” pace.

stories.title: Romania Needs Further Deficit Cuts to Boost Confidence, IMF Says
stories.summary: The International Monetary Fund called on Romania to lower the fiscal deficit further in order to maintain investors’ confidence and said higher interest rates may be needed to contain inflation risks.

stories.title: ECB’s Pereira Says Inflation Pressure Is Significant and Rising
stories.summary: European Central Bank Governing Council member Alvaro Santos Pereira said upward pressure on consumer prices is strong and is still building, comments that suggest he backs a further tightening of monetary policy.

stories.title: Wall Street Regulator Probing Nvidia’s Accounting, Reuters Says
stories.summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating the accounting practices of Nvidia Corp., Reuters reported Friday, as the challenges facing the chipmaker continue to mount in the wake of Jensen Huang’s departure as chief executive officer.

stories.title: Nasdaq 100 Tumbles 5% on Report of Nvidia Probe: Markets Wrap
stories.summary: Another bruising technology selloff rippled through markets around the world, driving US stocks toward their longest slide since 2020 as investors piled into the perceived safety of bonds.

stories.title: Morgan Stanley Sees Aussie Riding AI Storm to Outperform in 2027
stories.summary: The Australian dollar will stand out among developed-market currencies next year as it will reap the benefits of the artificial intelligence buildout, weathering the recent stock selloff, according to Andrew Watrous at Morgan Stanley.

stories.title: Apollo Enlists 13 Wall Street Banks for $9 Billion ADT Debt Deal
stories.summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. has brought in 13 Wall Street lenders for a roughly $9 billion debt package it underwrote for Thrive Holdings Inc.’s acquisition of home security provider ADT Inc., according to people familiar with the matter.

stories.title: Trump Defends Putin Ties as Russia Steps Up Ukraine Attacks
stories.summary: President Donald Trump defended his relationship with Vladimir Putin, repeatedly insisting that the Russian leader wants to end the war in Ukraine despite Moscow’s latest deadly assault.

stories.title: Trump Plays Down Tensions With Vance Over Iran War Critique
stories.summary: President Donald Trump denied a report that he voiced unhappiness with Vice President JD Vance for blaming the Republicans’ midterm wipeout on the war with Iran.

stories.summary: Gap on Thursday announced Ashley Kechter as the new CEO of Athleta. The retailer also reported mixed fiscal third-quarter earnings.

stories.title: Anthropic Falls After Blockbuster Debut as Tech Sells Off
stories.summary: Anthropic shares erased much of their first-day surge as the record-breaking listing faces its first test from public investors. Bloomberg's Shirin Ghaffary discusses what's ahead for the company with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
stories.ai_summary: Anthropic erased its initial listing gains as public market investors tested the company's valuation. The retreat comes as broader tech stocks face heightened volatility and profit taking.
stories.why_it_matters: Negative for AI tech sentiment as public markets re-evaluate high multi-billion valuations.

stories.title: S&P 500 Falls Deeper in Correction as AI Enthusiasm Unravels
stories.summary: The S&P 500 Index slid deeper into correction territory after a string of disappointing Big Tech earnings and scandal at Nvidia Corp. eroded confidence in the artificial intelligence trade over the last two weeks. Even Anthropic PBC’s record IPO did little to lift market sentiment.
stories.ai_summary: The S&P 500 Index slid further into correction territory following disappointing Big Tech earnings and executive turmoil at Nvidia. Investor confidence in the AI trade has rapidly diminished.
stories.why_it_matters: Negative for broad US equities as AI trade correction drags benchmark indices lower.

stories.title: Anthropic's $1.5 trillion debut rewrites venture capital's playbook
stories.summary: The AI lab's shares began trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday at a $1.5 trillion valuation, delivering multibillion-dollar windfalls to venture investors at a moment when the industry needs fresh liquidity to fund more bets on AI companies. The stock closed at $97.17, up 17% from its IPO price of $83.
stories.ai_summary: Anthropic began trading on the Nasdaq at a $1.5 trillion valuation, delivering significant returns to early venture backers. The landmark debut provides liquidity to an industry facing funding scrutiny.
stories.why_it_matters: Positive for venture capital liquidity, though public market digestion remains challenging.

stories.title: Anthropic Investor Sees Huge Runway Beyond Coding
stories.summary: Anthropic shares are retreating after their blockbuster debut, but T. Rowe Price’s Emma Norchet says the volatility doesn’t change the firm’s long-term outlook. One of Anthropic’s largest private investors, T. Rowe also participated in the IPO. Norchet discusses the company’s improving compute economics and the growth opportunity beyond coding, from knowledge work and cybersecurity to biology and robotics. She joins…
stories.ai_summary: T. Rowe Price equity managers reaffirmed their long-term positive outlook on Anthropic despite initial listing price volatility. Investors highlighted substantial growth opportunities beyond software coding applications.
stories.why_it_matters: Positive for long-term AI enterprise adoption thesis despite near-term equity swings.

stories.title: AMD shares fall after short seller report on China links
stories.summary: Chipmaker down by as much as 11% following warnings by Hunterbrook in the aftermath of Nvidia scandal
stories.ai_summary: AMD shares tumbled up to 11% following a short seller report detailing potential concerns over business ties in China. The decline adds to wider semiconductor industry headwinds following recent scandals.
stories.why_it_matters: Negative for semiconductor manufacturers and chip stocks amid heightened regulatory and short-seller scrutiny.

stories.title: Apple Working on Own AI Agent to Rival OpenAI and Anthropic
stories.summary: Anurag Rana, Senior Tech Analyst for Bloomberg Intelligence, discussed the latest from Apple with Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney. Apple Inc. is developing its own autonomous artificial intelligence agent that can get things done on behalf of users, looking to enter a fast-growing market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic PBC, Meta Platforms Inc. and others. The company outlined the plans in job listings added to…
stories.ai_summary: Apple is developing its own autonomous AI agent to compete with offerings from OpenAI and Anthropic. The project signals Apple's expanding efforts to capture market share in generative consumer AI.
stories.why_it_matters: Positive for Apple's long-term competitive positioning in consumer AI software.

stories.title: Anthropic staffer claims solution to mathematics’ Riemann hypothesis
stories.summary: Proof for 167-year-old problem would be most spectacular AI advance in field
stories.ai_summary: An Anthropic researcher claimed to have developed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis using artificial intelligence. If verified, the mathematical breakthrough would mark a milestone in AI capabilities.
stories.why_it_matters: Positive for fundamental AI technology validation and advanced scientific computing capabilities.

stories.title: Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation
stories.summary: Amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report and an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, sources tell WIRED the Nvidia board’s main issue was the former CEO’s “lack of candor.”
stories.ai_summary: Nvidia's board raised serious concerns over former CEO Jensen Huang's transparency before his resignation. The board was alarmed by misstatements alongside investigations into personal conduct and foreign contacts.
stories.why_it_matters: Negative for Nvidia corporate governance confidence and stock price valuation.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300
stories.summary: Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information. CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm "in time for the holidays in December," but […]
stories.ai_summary: Meta plans to price its upcoming Muse Charm AI hardware device at $300, according to industry reports. The compact display device enables users to interact directly with Meta's AI agent.
stories.why_it_matters: Neutral to positive for Meta's hardware monetization and consumer AI ecosystem expansion.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Nasdaq Debut Sparks Buying Rush Among Indian Retail Investors
stories.summary: Indian retail investors rushed to buy and trade Anthropic shares following its Nasdaq debut yesterday, with the Claude maker drawing…
stories.ai_summary: Indian retail investors logged heavy buying interest in Anthropic shares following its US stock market debut. Domestic trading platforms experienced surging volumes despite global tech weakness.
stories.why_it_matters: Positive for retail equity trading platforms and international investment access brokers.

stories.title: Indonesia asks Google to clarify removal of 19,000 YouTube channels, ministry says
stories.summary: Google routinely publishes a quarterly "influence operations bulletin", containing reports of terminations of accounts linked to countries such as China, India, and Indonesia as part of its "investigation into coordinated influence operations."

stories.title: Spacetech startup SatSure raises $7 million from sovereign space fund
stories.summary: Indian space startup SatSure has raised 600 million rupees ($7 million) from a government-backed space technology fund as part of an ongoing 2 billion rupees funding round, the company said on Friday.

stories.title: Anthropic Slips as AI Selloff Spreads
stories.summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Anthropic gives back its debut-day surge, while the selloff spreads from chips to metals and markets around the world. But there are still winners. Anthropic investor and General Catalyst’s Madhu Namburi joins us on what comes next for AI. Plus, Goldman’s David Mericle on why inflation could fall “substantially” by the end of 2027…

stories.title: Nvidia Employees Complained About Huang’s Behavior Years Ago
stories.summary: About two decades ago, two Nvidia Corp. employees complained about how then-Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang treated his staff, including allegations that he threatened them and made sexually explicit remarks, according to allegations contained in a California lawsuit filed in 2007.

stories.title: Anthropic Founder to Donate to Trump Accounts Following IPO, Bessent Says
stories.summary: Tom Brown, a co-founder and chief compute officer of Anthropic PBC, plans to announce a donation to Trump accounts, according to a person briefed on the matter.

stories.title: Anthropic Slides as AI Selloff Deepens
stories.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow takes a look at Anthropic shares falling after its blockbuster stock market debut, as part of a wider global tech selloff hitting the AI trade. And: Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived with record-breaking demand. (Source: Bloomberg)

stories.summary: Anthropic faced a market sell-off, raging anti-AI sentiment and a crisis at Nvidia in pulling off the largest IPO on record.

stories.title: Anthropic's IPO caps explosive growth period for AI startup, filled with contradictions
stories.summary: Today, the company that dedicated itself to prioritising safety, building the Claude chatbot along the way, has been one of the loudest voices raising warnings about how the same technology could bring catastrophe. It's one of the contradictions that mark the brief, colourful history of Anthropic, which emerged Thursday from its first day of trading on Wall Street with a market value of $1.75 trillion.

stories.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
stories.summary: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

stories.title: Big Take: Can Anthropic Weather a Shifting AI Landscape?
stories.summary: Volatility surged a day after the market debut of Anthropic. Worries over AI, geopolitics and rates are all weighing on investors’ appetite for risk. Ed Ludlow and Bailey Lipschultz join Sarah Holder on the Big Take podcast to explain. (Source: Bloomberg)

stories.title: OpenAI smartphone in the works? Foxconn subsidiary secures assembly orders; launch tipped for 2027-28
stories.summary: OpenAI is reportedly developing its first smartphone, with Foxconn subsidiary FIH Mobile said to have secured assembly orders. Reports suggest a launch in late 2027 or 2028, with MediaTek potentially supplying a custom processor. OpenAI and Foxconn have not confirmed the project.

stories.title: Microsoft to Pay Top Cloud Workers More, Crack Down on Others
stories.summary: Microsoft Corp. is making pay more performance-based in its crucial cloud division, the latest tech industry attempt to push employees to work even harder.

stories.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
stories.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades. stories.title: Intuit to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion
stories.summary: Intuit is offloading a segment that has slowed down revenue growth, for less than a third of what it paid to acquire Mailchimp in 2021.

stories.title: Anthropic’s 7 founders cashed out nearly $2B in record-breaking IPO
stories.summary: At the upgraded $83/share IPO price, Anthropic's seven founders each pocketed $280 million, while the company nabbed nearly $105 billion.
